display_name: The Martyrs of the Lavra of Saint Sabbas

names.form: Cuvioșii Mucenici din Mănăstirea Sfântului Sava cel Sfințit
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 20 martie.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες, των λεγομένων Μαύρων», with the rank word left off — the company's own name on the Greek calendar, the Abbades, those called the Black.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «În zilele preasfințitului patriarh al Ierusalimului, Ilie, care era al doilea cu același nume … iar în Constantinopol împărățind Constantin și Irina (780-797)». The reign is the interval the page prints; it gives no year for the killing, only that it fell on 20 March, Great Thursday.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 20 martie — «Sfinții Cuvioși Mucenici din Mănăstirea Sfântului Sava cel Sfințit»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες, των λεγομένων Μαύρων»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» Two things on this page do not agree with what the corpus already holds, and neither has been resolved in the row. It puts the raid «Στα χρόνια του Ηρακλείου (620 - 641 μ.Χ.)», in the reign of Heraclius, where doxologia's life put it under the patriarch Elias II with Constantine and Irene reigning (780–797), which is the interval the corpus's dates field carries; that field has not been touched. And it makes the fathers forty-four, «(44 κατά την παράδοση)», by tradition. It names the two accounts it rests on — Stephen the Sabbaite, kept on 13 Ιουλίου, nephew of John of Damascus, and Antiochus Pandectes, kept on 24 Δεκεμβρίου — says Theoctistus is mentioned among the Abbades, and adds that the memory of these venerable-martyrs is repeated on 16 Μαΐου, which is a second Greek day and a note rather than a second row.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Cuvioşi Mucenici din Mănăstirea Sfântului Sava cel Sfinţit

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received crowns of incorruption from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἁγιόλεκτοι ἄρνες, ἐξωρμημένοι ἐκ χωρῶν διαφόρων, τῇ Ποίμνῃ συνεδράμετε Σάββα τοῦ σοφοῦ· ὅθεν θανατούμενοι, ἀπηνείᾳ βαρβάρων, χαίροντες ἀνήλθετε, πρὸς οὐράνιον μάνδραν, καθάπερ Ὅσιοι καί Ἀθληταί, ἐκδυσωποῦντες, ὑπέρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὃ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες. This is the proper: it names the flock of wise Sabbas and the cruelty of the barbarians. The page prints a second apolytikion, Ἦχος β’ «Ἀθλοφόροι Κυρίου μακαρία ἡ γῆ», which is the common of martyrs, and a Μεγαλυνάριον and a Κάθισμα; none of those is taken here.

english.text: As lambs chosen for holiness by the Saviour, setting out from lands of many kinds, you ran together to the flock of wise Sabbas; whence, being put to death by the cruelty of barbarians, you went up rejoicing to the fold in heaven, as venerable ones and as prizewinners, entreating for our souls.

hymns.text: Τὴν τῶν ὁσίων θεόληπτον συνοδείαν, ταῖς τῶν Μαρτύρων διαλάμπουσαν ἀκτῖσι, πάντες τοῖς ᾄσμασι στεφανώσωμεν, τοὺς τῷ Χριστῷ τυθέντας, οἷάπερ θεῖα σφάγια· αὐτούς γὰρ ὁ Λόγος προσεδέξατο.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τήν ἐν πρεσβείαις, on the page of Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες. It is proper to the company: a God-possessed brotherhood of venerable ones shining with the martyrs' rays.

english.text: Let us all crown with songs the God-possessed company of the venerable, shining with the rays of the martyrs, who were offered up to Christ as divine victims; for the Word himself received them.
